tasks.title: Architecture freeze: end-to-end request pipeline contract, audit-record schema and demo storyline
acceptance_criteria: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md defines one request path: identity -> prompt preflight -> authorized secure RAG -> generator backend -> grounding gate -> tool/MCP authorization -> extraction admission -> audit record

Typed Python interface for GeneratorBackend (generate(system, context, user) -> text + metadata) and AuditRecord fields (model id/version, retrieval ids, steering profile id, evidence_type, verdicts, latency) is specified and consistent with existing gateway.py/rag.py
Interface stubs committed in model_mountain/contracts.py with docstrings only plus an import test
Demo storyline (unprotected vs protected, same poisoned doc + compromised MCP tool + extraction burst) is written as docs/DEMO_STORYLINE.md and maps each beat to a judging criterion
Decision recorded in the hub with record_decision

tasks.title: Research: SpartHill IBM challenge requirements checklist, responsible-AI framing, and free IBM Granite runtime choice
acceptance_criteria: docs/SUBMISSION_CHECKLIST.md lists every Devpost requirement (title, team, summary, description questions: problem, who is affected, what it does, how AI contributes, tools/datasets, impact, limitations/next steps; demo video <=3 min or live link; public repo with README setup; AI-use disclosure; no secrets) with an owner task ID
Judging rubric (Technical Execution, Innovation, Challenge Fit & Real-World Impact, Feasibility & Implementation) mapped to concrete Model Mountain evidence

docs/RESEARCH_NOTES.md recommends a free local IBM Granite runtime that runs on the owner's Windows machine (e.g. Ollama granite model tag or HF transformers), with exact model ID, size, license and install command, each with a primary-source URL
Responsible-AI mapping to NIST AI RMF and OWASP LLM Top 10 categories with primary-source links; no invented statistics

tasks.title: Live IBM Granite generator backend (opt-in, fail-closed) implementing the GeneratorBackend contract
acceptance_criteria: model_mountain/backends.py provides an Ollama/OpenAI-compatible local backend and the existing extractive fixture behind the same contract; selected by explicit flag/env, never silently
Backend failure or timeout yields an abstention/withheld verdict, never unprotected output
Every live output is labeled evidence_type=LIVE with model id/tag and latency; CPU fixture stays CPU_SYNTHETIC
Unit tests with mocked HTTP cover success, timeout, malformed response and refusal-to-fallback; full suite still passes
One real smoke run against local Granite recorded (or a documented blocker if the runtime is unavailable)

tasks.title: End-to-end assistant pipeline wiring gateway + secure RAG + backend with persisted audit trail
acceptance_criteria: model_mountain/pipeline.py implements the MM-01 request path using existing gateway.py, rag.py, mcp_security.py and extraction.py without weakening deny-by-default authorization
Protected and unprotected modes run the same scenario so the demo can compare them; unprotected mode is clearly labeled as a baseline
AuditRecord JSONL written per request; no secrets or raw activations in records
Tests: tenant crossing, poisoned source, compromised MCP manifest, extraction burst, benign request completes; full suite passes
python -m model_mountain.pipeline --scenario helpdesk --output model_mountain_results/pipeline runs on CPU

tasks.title: Held-out benchmark set and A/B/D evaluation harness with uncertainty intervals
acceptance_criteria: examples/heldout/ contains >=60 independently labeled cases (benign tasks, direct/indirect injection, poisoned documents, unauthorized tool requests, extraction patterns) with group IDs preventing train/test leakage against existing examples

model_mountain/benchmark.py computes attack success rate, false refusal rate, supported-claim rate, appropriate abstention, benign completion and p50/p95 latency with Wilson 95% intervals and sample sizes
Conditions: A bare backend, B secure RAG, D full external controls + RAG; C (MIA steering) slot present but reported NOT_RUN unless MM-14 produces real evidence
Reports carry evidence_type per row; CPU fixture results can never be emitted as LIVE
Tests for metric math and leakage checks; full suite passes

Existing dashboard tabs keep working; app starts with streamlit run app.py with no network if fixture backend is selected
